name: Keyboard path matches the visual path
rule: Tab and screen-reader order follows the visual reading order. Adjust the order only where layout alone gets it wrong.

leaders.note: Focus follows source order, so the source is arranged to give a predictable flow: header, navigation, content, footer.
Traversal defaults to left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Groups and indexes are applied only where that default misreads the layout.
